notes: Definition authored from the record's committed deep-research report under research/habitats/, read in full; no new paid research was commissioned. requested_label: inland saline or alkaline aquatic environment
definition: An aquatic environment which is determined by an inland water body whose water is substantially more saline than fresh water, substantially more alkaline than circumneutral water, or both.
notes: Definition curated from the committed deep-research report for this record (#110, #185). The “or both” wording preserves GOLD's disjunctive hierarchy instead of claiming every child is simultaneously saline and alkaline. “Inland” is preferred to “non-marine” because marine-derived inland brines can remain geographically inland, while “athalassohaline” is not an exact synonym because it classifies water by ionic composition rather than location. Parent replacement is intentional: GOLD's inherited aquatic-biome edge is false for the node's operated-setting descendants, whereas ENVO's aquatic-environment genus covers both natural and engineered water-determined settings. Dropped the exact synonym 'Non-marine-Saline-and-Alkaline' (#213): it is BacDive's label for the concept GOLD spells 'Non-marine Saline and Alkaline', and the two differ only in punctuation. Both source labels survive on the record's source_attestations, where they identify which source said what; as a pair of EXACT synonyms they would read to an ENVO editor as the same string written twice. Found by the guard added for this issue, not by the review that filed it. Scope correction #1415: remove the three saline-only exact aliases because they omit the alkaline-only arm. Preserve the disjunctive definition, aquatic-environment REPLACE mode, reviewed source merge and separate assertion units.

No new research was commissioned. FOODON:03412113 'bivalve' is a food-product class rather than a host organism, so it is the wrong kind of term entirely and is not used. ADD keeps the GOLD parent and the already-present ENVO:01001002, of which the tighter genus is a descendant. Dropped the exact synonym 'Bivalvia-associated environment' (#213): it was coined at authoring time to mirror the requested label, is attested by no source and proposed by no report, and an exact synonym asserts that people actually use the name. Genus moved from ENVO:01001176 'environment associated with an aquatic invertebrate' to ENVO:01001002 (#210), with the whole aquatic-invertebrate host family rather than record by record - #210 was filed over three records and the genus is actually held by five, so fixing only the three would have rebuilt the same split it reports. Both terms are true of the concept, so this chooses between two true genera on what each drags in: ENVO asserts ENVO:01001176 under ENVO:01001002 AND ENVO:01001055 'environment associated with an animal part or small animal', so the tighter genus makes every descendant inherit a size-and-partonomy restriction that is false of a whole adult sponge, ascidian, oyster, giant clam or sea urchin. ENVO's own modelling is the decisive evidence: ENVO:01001179 'cnidarian-associated environment' - the closest analogue, a taxon-scoped class over aquatic invertebrates - is asserted under ENVO:01001002 ALONE, and ENVO:01001176 has no children in the slice at all. Not carried as an xref: it is genuinely broader, so recording it would re-import the ancestry this declines.

definition: An environmental system determined by an aquatic macrophyte, or by a part of an aquatic macrophyte.
notes: Rationale corrected under #1342; definition, label, synonym and genus retained from claude-opus-5's 2026-08-28 curation based on the committed deep-research report, read in full. Aquatic bryophytes are plants: NCBITaxon:3208 (Bryophyta) lies within Viridiplantae and Embryophyta (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/Taxonomy/Browser/wwwtax.cgi?id=3208). Green algae are also Viridiplantae; macroalgae must not all be described as non-plants. Retain ENVO:01001000 rather than narrow to ENVO:01001001 'plant-associated environment' because the source includes seaweed without an identified algal lineage (https://bacdive.dsmz.de/strain/158685); that evidence does not establish that every macrophyte host is a green plant. This wording correction does not resolve the digester and field-water source-scope finding in #1341 or endorse those associations as living-host observations. No new paid research was commissioned.

Labelled 'brown algal embryo' and not 'embryo' on the report's explicit instruction: the bare label must not be the definiendum, because in GOLD 'Embryo' is a reusable life-stage slot - the same thing MIxS models as host_life_stage - and two sibling nodes carry it under Red algae and under Fish. definition: An animal-associated environment which is determined by a fertilised fish egg during development, comprising the chorion surface, the perivitelline space and the developing embryo within.
notes: Definition authored from the record's committed deep-research report under research/habitats/, read in full; the report's proposed sentence, genus and near-miss table are the evidence. No new research was commissioned. Sibling of the brown algal embryo row and distinguished from it by label rather than by a shared term (#161). The whole-egg reading is the report's recommendation and the one the sampling literature uses - studies homogenise or swab the whole egg, not a dissected embryo. definition: An animal-associated environment which is determined by an echinoderm or by a part of an echinoderm.
notes: Definition authored from the record's committed deep-research report under research/habitats/, read in full; no new research was commissioned. Completes the invertebrate ladder (#222): invertebrate-, mollusc- and tunicate-associated environment were already authored at this rung on ENVO:01001002, and the echinoderm branch was the only one with neither a term nor an ontology parent - which is how it stayed unnoticed, since a record with no ontology parent is invisible to every ancestry-based screen. Worded exactly like the mollusc and tunicate siblings. FOODON:03412115 'echinoderm' and NCBITaxon:7586 stay xrefs: the phylum is a class of organisms, not a place (#99, #114). Genus is ENVO:01001002 and NOT the ENVO:01001176 this report recommends (#210, #222). The report is the fourth on this family to reach that recommendation and it makes the case against itself more clearly than any of the others: its own near-miss table rejects ENVO:01001055 'environment associated with an animal part or small animal' because 'the source concept is whole organisms across five classes spanning millimetre brittle stars to metre-long holothurians', and ENVO asserts ENVO:01001176 as a subclass of exactly that term - so the recommended genus imports the restriction the same paragraph refuses. The report also cites ENVO:01001179 'cnidarian-associated environment' as precedent for phylum-level granularity and notes it is asserted DIRECTLY under ENVO:01001002; that is the fact which decides against ENVO:01001176 rather than for it. Recorded rather than silently overridden, because a report is evidence for a curator and not an input. Dropped the exact synonym 'Echinodermata-associated environment' before merge (#229): it was coined at authoring time to mirror the requested label and is attested by no source and proposed by no report - the same construction #213 removed for 'Bivalvia-associated environment'. It passes the guard added there because it does not squash to the requested label, which is why that guard is not sufficient on its own. The GOLD source label is kept.

definition: A human construction which rejects waste heat from a recirculating water loop by evaporating part of that water into an air stream drawn through the structure, and which retains the remaining water in an open basin between passes.

definition: A gaseous environmental material which is discharged from an anthropogenic process to a stack or to abatement equipment, and which bears a load of volatile organic, nitrogenous or reduced-sulfur pollutants.
notes: Definition authored from the record's committed deep-research report under research/habitats/, read in full; no new paid research was commissioned. definition: A fermentation starter which consists of cereal flour and water acidified by the growth of lactic acid bacteria and yeasts, and which is maintained in a metabolically active state by repeated backslopping until baking ends it.

definition: An environmental material which has elevated concentrations of one or more persistent organic pollutants and which is targeted for microbially mediated remediation.
notes: Definition authored from the record's committed deep-research report under research/habitats/, read in full; no new paid research was commissioned. GOLD places the leaf under Engineered > Bioremediation and names a contaminant class rather than a sampled substance, so the record denotes the contaminated matrix being remediated, not the persistent organic pollutants themselves. ENVO:00010483 'environmental material' is the tightest vendored genus broad enough to cover POP-contaminated soil, sediment, sludge and water; ENVO:00002116 'contaminated soil' and ENVO:03600001 'chemically contaminated sediment' remain narrower material-specific near misses, and ENVO:00002204 'anthropogenic contamination feature' is a geographic feature rather than a material. The definition uses criteria-based persistent organic pollutants instead of the current Stockholm Convention list because PAHs sit under this source path in GOLD and are covered by CLRTAP rather than Stockholm.

definition: An anaerobic bioreactor which removes dissolved organic matter from a wastewater stream under conditions lacking dissolved oxygen and oxidized nitrogen.
notes: Definition authored from the committed deep-research report; no new paid research was commissioned. definition: A marine hydrothermal vent chimney which is built of brucite and calcium and magnesium carbonates precipitated where low-temperature, hyperalkaline, hydrogen- and methane-rich fluid produced by serpentinization of ultramafic rock mixes with seawater.
notes: Definition authored from a Carbonate evidence review. The review checked ten of the twelve current organism assertions against the 2021 GOLD export and isolate descriptions, found only Prony Hydrothermal Field carbonate-chimney isolates, and concluded that GOLD's bare Carbonate leaf denotes a serpentinization-driven carbonate chimney rather than carbonate-rich soda-lake water. ENVO:01000129 'marine hydrothermal vent chimney' is the tightest vendored genus because existing alkaline-water, microbialite, carbonate-rock and smoker terms describe the wrong material, process or vent type. parent_mode=REPLACE intentionally drops the inherited Alkaline parent because it is marked NOT_APPLICABLE and because this leaf is marine or intertidal despite GOLD's Non-marine bucket. Two organism rows added after the local 2021 GOLD export remain unchecked because live GOLD fetches returned 403.

definition: An environmental material which is a portion of saturated rock or unconsolidated sediment that composes the solid matrix of an aquifer.

definition: A manufactured product designed to remove gaseous or particulate contaminants from an air or waste-gas stream by contacting the stream with a scrubbing medium.
notes: Scope correction (#1887; structured review 20261010T225034Z-air_scrubber F1). EPA describes spray towers, venturi and other wet scrubbers (https://www.epa.gov/air-emissions-monitoring-knowledge-base/monitoring-control-technique-wet-scrubber-particulate-0); packing and recirculation are not universal. The prior research report inferred a packed wet design from context without direct GOLD member evidence. Retain the generic scrubbing device without assuming a liquid medium, packing, recirculation, biofilm or biological degradation. Remove unverified exact aliases air washer, gas scrubber and wet scrubber rather than asserting identical scope. Keep ENVO:00003074 'manufactured product' and parent_mode=REPLACE: a device is not a portion of Indoor Air. No exact identity with ENVO:00003968 'air filter' or member-level design certification is asserted; its biofilm child remains separately tracked in #1637.

definition: An anthropogenic environment which is bounded by the stations, running tunnels, trains, and other enclosed structures of a predominantly subterranean urban rapid transit system.

definition: A biofilm which grows on an interior surface of an air scrubber.

definition: A reproductive gland in the mantle cavity of female decapodiform cephalopods that develops epithelium-lined tubules supporting an extracellular bacterial consortium. Developing glands can precede sexual maturity and dense colonization; mature glands can supply bacteria to egg jelly.
notes: Scientific follow-up #2129 to the 2026-09-10 definition: PMID:34129444 (DOI:10.1086/713965) documents pre-maturity ANG development in Euprymna scolopes; PMID:34602537 (DOI:10.1264/jsme2.ME21030), Methods and Fig. 1, recognizes juvenile ANG without bacterial aggregates and immature ANG with colonies in Sepioteuthis lessoniana. PMID:40231847 (DOI:10.1128/aem.02163-24) supports mature tubule and egg-jelly transfer features. Qualify those features instead of making maturity or dense colonization necessary identity conditions. Preserve the organ identity, exact aliases, verified reproductive-gland genus and CEPH external xref. ADD retains only independently valid parents; the false whole reproductive-system source edge is explicitly guarded out under #2128, not endorsed as a genus. Original primary-evidence limits remain in review 20261014T200255Z-accessory_nidamental_gland_ang; no new paid research.

definition: An environmental material which is part of an engineered bioremediation system, is exposed to methane-containing gas, and supports microbially mediated methane oxidation.
notes: Rationale correction (#1793) preserves the definition authored on 2026-09-10. Under the retained material interpretation, ENVO:00010483 'environmental material' covers the methane-exposed matrix; ENVO:00002152 'biofilter', ENVO:00002123 'bioreactor', and ENVO:00002124 'anaerobic bioreactor' denote devices rather than matrices. ENVO:00002124 specifies nonoxygenated contents, not methane production. Stultiens et al. 2020 (https://doi.org/10.1007/s00253-020-10748-z), establishment methods and enrichment results, demonstrates methane oxidation in an anoxic reactor. That experiment is a counterexample to the former rationale, not a crosswalk to GOLD's original members. Original source-member matrix and gas-exposure scope remain unverified; the definition is preserved pending source reconstruction. CHEBI:16183 remains a chemical-only xref, and parent_mode=REPLACE continues to exclude the inherited Hydrocarbon chemical class rather than asserting it is a broader habitat.

definition: An anatomical entity environment which is determined by a caseating granuloma formed in host tissue in response to infection by members of the Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex.
notes: Definition authored from the record's committed deep-research report under research/habitats/, read in full; no new paid research was commissioned. The report interprets PREGO's BTO:0002173 'tubercle' source as the tuberculosis pathology sense because the PREGO synonyms include tubercle while the high-scoring taxa are dominated by Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex genomes. The BTO, UBERON, and PO tubercle terms are homonyms for schistosome bosses, normal anatomical protrusions, and plant protrusions; ENVO lacks a tuberculous granuloma or infectious lesion class, so ENVO:2100000 'anatomical entity environment' is the tightest vendored genus for a pathological host-tissue structure. The definition is intentionally restricted to Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex granulomas because the lone Mycobacterium leprae PREGO taxon is likely lexical spillover from PREGO's co-mention method rather than evidence for a leprosy lesion habitat.

definition: An animal-associated environment which is determined by an insect in its non-feeding prepupal phase, after the end of larval feeding and before pupation.
notes: Definition authored from the record's committed deep-research report under research/habitats/, read in full; no new paid research was commissioned. GOLD's Host-associated > Arthropoda: Insects > Prepupa source denotes an insect acting as a whole-host microbial habitat under #112/#114, not UBERON:0003142 or BTO:0001110 organism-at-stage identities, BTO:0001459 white prepupa, UBERON:0013198 cocoon, the pupal meconium, a larva/pupa/nymph sibling, a time interval, rearing substrate, or insect food product. The wording uses the report's functional non-feeding, post-larval, pre-pupal reading to span dipteran, black soldier fly, and hymenopteran prepupa usages while avoiding UBERON's stricter pupariation boundary.
